Campaign complete. Recap for **Nuzzlesprig Books — The Lantern in the Snow** (Nov 25–Dec 2, 2026, ET):

**What ran**
- One campaign (`vpxvq`), two ad groups, targeted US + Canada, ages 21+ only (`AGE_OVER_21`), optimized for the "Drawing entered" web conversion (pixel `41w6h`), $750 cap.
- Ad group A (`290t7`, post …8529 "Christmas gift" angle): paused Nov 27 after it trailed on conversions; ~$90 spent.
- Ad group B (`z8k0a`, post …3099, eligibility/clear angle): the workhorse — budget raised to $63/day on Nov 27, then $110/day on Nov 29; ~$655 spent. Paused at flight end.

**Results (Nov 25–Dec 2)**
- Spend: **~$745** (under the $750 budget)
- Impressions: **~614,000**
- Link clicks: **234**
- Completed entries ("Drawing entered" conversions): **28** (2 from A, 26 from B)

**Notes / discrepancies**
- Post **2123642491501722570** ("Your woodland creature could light up…") could not be found in the account — list/get returned nothing, so it was never promoted. The other two contest posts ran (…529 and …3099). The generic "take a look at our website" post (…528) was not used — no contest message, poor fit for entry volume.
- Spend/impression totals for Nov 25 were taken from a mid-flight snapshot; the stats endpoint caps the query window at 7 days + 1 hour, so full-flight figures are Nov 25 snapshot + Nov 26–Dec 3 window. Numbers are accurate to within the tool's reporting.
- Post …3099 (clear eligibility + free + 21+ framing) decisively outperformed the Christmas-gift angle on conversions (~13x signups), so budget was concentrated there mid-flight.
